path_block:
/v1/admin/billing/metering/pricing:
    get:
      tags:
        - Administration
      operationId: getAdminMeteringPricing
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: none
      x-kokoro-permission: admin.billing.metering.manage
      summary: Read latest published metering configuration (not an active price quote)
      description: >-
        One owner RR snapshot of the latest published tenant rate and policy, independently nullable and
        possibly future-effective. Not an active price quote or proof of an unknown command outcome. No query,
        body, Content-Type, framing or command headers. Current platform administrator only.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Latest published configuration, not necessarily effective
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdminMeteringPricingResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadGateway'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable'
  /v1/admin/billing/metering/rate-revisions:
    post:
      tags:
        - Administration
      operationId: publishAdminMeteringRate
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: admin.billing.metering.manage
      summary: Publish immutable metering rates
      description: >-
        Current platform administrator and trusted tenant/actor are rechecked before one dispatch. Strict JSON
        up to 1MiB and 12 levels, no query or CAS headers. Preserve original publication_id, key, reason,
        complete configuration and its explicit UTC times on unknown outcome; reading latest configuration does
        not prove no publication occurred. No model request or funds effect.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 8
            maxLength: 128
            pattern: ^[\x21-\x2b\x2d-\x7e]{8,128}$(?![\s\S])
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdminMeteringRatePublishRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Exact immutable publication receipt or original receipt replay
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPublicationResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadGateway'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable'
      x-kokoro-max-body-bytes: 1048576
      x-kokoro-max-json-depth: 12
  /v1/admin/billing/metering/policy-revisions:
    post:
      tags:
        - Administration
      operationId: publishAdminMeteringPolicy
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: admin.billing.metering.manage
      summary: Publish immutable metering policy and integer budget
      description: >-
        Current platform administrator and trusted tenant/actor are rechecked before one dispatch. Strict JSON
        up to 1MiB and 12 levels, no query or CAS headers. Preserve original publication_id, key, reason,
        complete configuration and its explicit UTC times on unknown outcome; reading latest configuration does
        not prove no publication occurred. No model request or funds effect.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 8
            maxLength: 128
            pattern: ^[\x21-\x2b\x2d-\x7e]{8,128}$(?![\s\S])
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdminMeteringPolicyPublishRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Exact immutable publication receipt or original receipt replay
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPublicationResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'
        '502':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadGateway'
        '503':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable'
      x-kokoro-max-body-bytes: 1048576
      x-kokoro-max-json-depth: 12
schema_block:
MeteringRational:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - numerator
        - denominator
      properties:
        numerator:
          type: string
          pattern: ^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,77})$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 78
        denominator:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,77}$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 78
    MeteringRate:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - provider_ref
        - environment
        - pricing_account_ref
        - model_ref
        - model_version
        - bucket
        - unit
        - applicability
        - currency_code
        - minor_per_unit
      properties:
        provider_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        environment:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        pricing_account_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        model_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        model_version:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        bucket:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        unit:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        applicability:
          oneOf:
            - type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                - kind
              properties:
                kind:
                  type: string
                  const: all
            - type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required:
                - kind
                - dimension
                - unit
                - lower_inclusive
                - upper_exclusive
              properties:
                kind:
                  type: string
                  const: range
                dimension:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 1
                  maxLength: 128
                unit:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 1
                  maxLength: 128
                lower_inclusive:
                  type: string
                  pattern: ^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,77})$(?![\s\S])
                  maxLength: 19
                upper_exclusive:
                  type:
                    - string
                    - 'null'
                  pattern: ^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$(?![\s\S])
                  maxLength: 19
        currency_code:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$
        minor_per_unit:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRational'
    MeteringRateConfiguration:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - effective_from
        - source_ref
        - verified_at
        - rates
      properties:
        effective_from:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        source_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        verified_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        rates:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 64
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRate'
    MeteringPolicyConfiguration:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - effective_from
        - source_ref
        - verified_at
        - currency_code
        - multiplier
        - credit_micros_per_minor
        - max_attempt_credits
      properties:
        effective_from:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        source_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        verified_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        currency_code:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$
        multiplier:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRational'
        credit_micros_per_minor:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRational'
        max_attempt_credits:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,12}$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 13
          description: Whole Credits, 1 through 9223372036854. A spending budget, not a supplier cost guarantee.
    AdminMeteringRatePublishRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - publication_id
        - reason
        - configuration
      properties:
        publication_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$(?![\s\S])
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
        configuration:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRateConfiguration'
    AdminMeteringPolicyPublishRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - publication_id
        - reason
        - configuration
      properties:
        publication_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$(?![\s\S])
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
        configuration:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPolicyConfiguration'
    MeteringPublication:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - kind
        - revision
        - content_digest
        - published_at
        - effective_from
      properties:
        kind:
          type: string
          enum:
            - rate
            - policy
        revision:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 19
        content_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$(?![\s\S])
        published_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        effective_from:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
    MeteringPublicationResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - data
        - meta
      properties:
        data:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPublication'
        meta:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/RequestMeta'
    MeteringRateRevision:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - revision
        - content_digest
        - published_at
        - configuration
      properties:
        revision:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 19
        content_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$(?![\s\S])
        published_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        configuration:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRateConfiguration'
    MeteringPolicyRevision:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - revision
        - content_digest
        - published_at
        - configuration
      properties:
        revision:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$(?![\s\S])
          maxLength: 19
        content_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$(?![\s\S])
        published_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
        configuration:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPolicyConfiguration'
    AdminMeteringPricingResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - data
        - meta
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required:
            - rate_revision
            - policy_revision
          properties:
            rate_revision:
              anyOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringRateRevision'
                - type: 'null'
            policy_revision:
              anyOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/MeteringPolicyRevision'
                - type: 'null'
        meta:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/RequestMeta'
